bigg_baker.text: Howay in, hinny! Mind the stottie, it is bigger than your head.
Bigg is an old word for a hardy kind of barley, and this market sold grain long before it sold anything else.
Pease pudding and ham in a stottie is proper Geordie scran. Scran is food, in case you wondered.

then.text: Another pie? Divvent be greedy. Off you go, pet.

else.text: Here, a pork pie for the road. Eat it before the chipgulls spot it.
